title: ASD-STE100 plugin scaffolding and registration
description: As a Limatus maintainer, I want the ASD-STE100 rule set to load and register like the existing bot-slop diagnosis checks, so that operators can opt a style profile into STE rules without forking the diagnose pipeline. Spec first: define the profile-preset load path, checks gating keys, and finding-kind registration before any code.
